actions.name: false appearance
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name monster]]{monster} remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

actions.name: grasping tendrils
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a [[/check]] check against it.

actions.name: tendril
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. Hit: The target is &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the target is &Reference[restrained] and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws , and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't use the same [[lookup @item.name]] on another target.

actions.name: reel
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} pulls each creature &reference[grappled apply=false] by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes four attacks with its [[/item .bTiw89tDx64zTqDk]]{tendrils}, uses [[/item .iGuyFLbKazqPCcXY]]{reel}, and makes one attack with its [[/item .mBRjMwEitGrPDm5I]]{bite}.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
